summary: U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results (net revenue of $223 million, up 13% year over year; net income attributable to USPH of $11 million versus $13 million) and announced a quarterly dividend of $0.46 per share payable December 11, 2026 to holders of record November 16, 2026. The filing includes Item 2.02 results of operations and Item 8.01 other events, with the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine earnings and dividend current report, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
